verifications.claim: A mistaken Denver Police "All Clear" emergency alert was sent citywide on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Saturday afternoon... "All Clear" alert was intended... but was mistakenly sent to "everyone" instead'; R2: 'on Saturday... all-clear alert mistakenly went out to the entire city'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm mistaken citywide 'All Clear' alert on a Saturday after robbery, but do not specify exact date April 18, 2026, making support less precise.

verifications.claim: The mistaken Denver Police "All Clear" emergency alert was sent instead of only to the immediate area of West Gunnison Drive and South Zuni Street.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'shelter-in-place order for a one-block radius around [Gunnison Drive and Zuni Street]... intended to be sent to the residents under the shelter-in-place order, but was mistakenly sent to "everyone"'; R2: 'one-block radius of W Gunnison Place and S Zuni Street... all-clear alert intended for the same people in that one-block radius. It went to the entire city instead'
verifications.reasoning: Both references directly state the alert was intended for the one-block area around Gunnison/Zuni but sent citywide.

verifications.claim: The Denver Police "All Clear" emergency alert followed a robbery.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the alert was linked to a robbery'; R2: 'after two armed robbery suspects fled'
verifications.reasoning: Both references explicitly link the 'All Clear' alert to following a robbery.

verifications.claim: Denver7 and CBS News reported a subsequent shelter-in-place order.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 (CBS): 'issued a shelter-in-place order for a one-block radius'; R2 (Denver7): 'residents in a one-block radius... had received a shelter-in-place alert'
verifications.reasoning: Both Denver7 (R2) and CBS (R1) directly report the shelter-in-place order issued after the robbery.

verifications.claim: The incident occurred near the southwest Denver intersection of W. Gunnison Dr. and S. Zuni St.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'robbery that occurred at the intersection of Gunnison Drive and Zuni Street'; R2: 'W Gunnison Place and S Zuni Street in southwest Denver'
verifications.reasoning: Both references place the incident at the Gunnison/Zuni intersection in southwest Denver (minor street name variation: Drive/Place).

verifications.claim: Two armed robbery suspects fled into a nearby residence.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'two suspects fled into a nearby residence'; R2: 'two armed robbery suspects fled'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states suspects fled into residence; R2 confirms armed robbery suspects fled (context implies residence).

verifications.claim: Two armed robbery suspects fleeing into a nearby residence prompted a localized shelter-in-place order for a one-block radius.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'two suspects fled into a nearby residence... issued a shelter-in-place order for a one-block radius'; R2: 'after two armed robbery suspects fled... residents in a one-block radius... had received a shelter-in-place alert'
verifications.reasoning: Both directly connect suspects fleeing (into residence in R1) to the one-block shelter-in-place order.

verifications.claim: After both suspects were apprehended, the "All Clear" alert was intended only for that neighborhood.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'two suspects... were later arrested... "All Clear" alert was intended to be sent to the residents under the shelter-in-place order'; R2: 'after the suspects were taken into custody... all-clear alert intended for the same people in that one-block radius'
verifications.reasoning: Both confirm 'All Clear' intended only for the local area/neighborhood after apprehension.

verifications.claim: The "All Clear" alert was sent to the entire city.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'mistakenly sent to "everyone" instead'; R2: 'mistakenly went out to the entire city'
verifications.reasoning: Both explicitly state the alert was sent citywide.

verifications.claim: This was the second incident this year where a localized emergency alert was accidentally sent citywide in Denver.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A similar issue occurred in January'; R2: 'It's the second time an emergency alert has mistakenly gone out to the whole city this year. In January...'
verifications.reasoning: Both directly state it is the second such incident this year, referencing January.

verifications.claim: Denver Police and Denver 911 are currently investigating the cause of the alert system failure.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'police are working with the Department of Safety/Denver 911 to determine why the alert was sent further than intended'; R2: 'Denver Police are working with the Department of Safety/Denver 911 to identify why that happened'
verifications.reasoning: Both confirm ongoing investigation by Denver Police and Denver 911 into the cause.
